messages:
mira: opened a quick docs PR to add the status page permalink + a short workaround for yesterday's inference failover. Need 1-2 reviewers and a green preview so we can merge before today's customer sync.
alex: drop the PR link?
mira: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499  Changes: add status.redwood.com permalink to /operational/incidents, Known Issue: KV-cache invalidation on autoscaler failover, JS + Python SDK retry examples, and a short "what to do" workaround for SREs and customers.
sam: will review content. FYI docs CI was flaky earlier, might need an include fix.
docs-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #499  error: include file not found: incidents/snippets/status-permalink.md; refer to logs at https://ci.redwood.com/build/9921
lina: I can add the missing snippet. Also propose clarifying the Dedicated note: callers may see queued requests during model fallback and should expect transient 503s.
mira: thanks, pushed the snippet and added the Dedicated note. Re-ran preview.
deploy-bot: Preview published: https://deploy-preview-499--docs.redwood.com  please verify the rendered Known Issue section.
alex: quick nit: Python SDK sample uses `retry=3` but we prefer explicit backoff + max_retries. Suggest:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
client.generate(model="redwood-7b", prompt="...", timeout_ms=90000, max_retries=5, backoff_ms=200)
```
Also mark block as python.
mira: updated snippet to use max_retries/backoff and timeout_ms. force-pushed.
sam: will run a staging smoke once preview is promoted. @deploy-bot can you promote?
deploy-bot: Promotion to staging started for PR #499  status: in-progress.
sre_kate: add the detection query we used to the docs under "How we detect it":
```promql
sum(rate(inference_errors_total[1m])) by (region,model)
```
and include a permalink to the status incident: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2025-03-14-inference-failover-2
mira: added promql and status permalink. Also added a short ops workaround: restart affected inference workers, and if on Dedicated, trigger a manual model-fallback with the admin UI.
lina: one more request: add a small migration note for SDK users who relied on automatic retries in older clients.
mira: added migration blurb. Docs-preview looks good to me.
sam: staging smoke passed (latency/504s check). I approve, merging if infra checks pass.
merge-bot: All required approvals present for PR #499. Running final CI checks.
docs-bot: final docs-build succeeded for PR #499.
merge-bot: PR #499 merged into main by mira at 1759009200. Changelog auto-generated and queued for review.
alex: great, I'll notify Support and update the KB pointers.
mira: thanks all. I'll open a small follow-up PR to backport the snippet into the internal ops-runbook and add a short release-note entry.
